overview: NCERT Bhaiya is a gamified educational platform for NCERT (Classes 1–12) and IIT JEE content, featuring quizzes, flashcards, leaderboard, blog, community chat, and admin panel. Now with Focus Mode — a camera-based identity check that ensures only the registered student earns XP during a quiz.
features: Quiz system with XP and streaks
Focus Mode with facial recognition per quiz
